source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 13 februarie — «Sfântul Ierarh Evloghie, Patriarhul Alexandriei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιος Ευλόγιος Αρχιεπίσκοπος Αλεξάνδρειας»

attestations.note: saint.gr heads him «(; - 607)», gives his years in the see as 579–607, and calls him archbishop where this folder's types say patriarch. It also lists what survives of his writing: seven chapters of «Περί των δύο φύσεων του Κυρίου και Θεού και Σωτήρος ημών Ιησού Χριστού», fragments of a discourse on the Trinity and the divine economy, and a homily on the palms and the colt whose authenticity it calls doubtful.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «παρέδωσε την αγία του ψυχή στα χέρια Του το 607 μ.Χ.», its heading «(; - 607)», and its years for the see, «στα χρόνια 579 - 607 μ.Χ.»
